P038.name: USB dry-cabinet environmental logger
P038.connection: RH, temperature and sample age → validated record → host CSV
P038.trial: Distinguish new samples, carried-forward readings, startup without data and expired readings.
P038.physical: Compare against a reference humidity instrument and log a real USB disconnect and reconnect.

P043.name: Custom four-wire harness checker
P043.connection: One enabled source pin → unpowered harness → four observed return pins
P043.trial: Test an exact four-wire cross-harness against every single open, output swap and pairwise bridge.
P043.physical: Confirm the exact mating connectors and continuity on an unpowered known-good cable, then test fault plugs.

P065.name: Buffered digital timing capture pod
P065.connection: Eight square-wave inputs → buffer → common sample clock → edge records
P065.trial: Determine which capture interval can see the shortest specified pulse at every sampled phase.
P065.physical: Measure input thresholds, shortest detectable pulse width, interchannel skew and crosstalk on the populated pod.

P067.name: Stepper winding identification and jog station
P067.connection: Four disconnected motor leads → resistance matrix → bipolar winding pairing
P067.trial: Recover both coil pairs under all lead permutations and reject an open coil and an intercoil bridge.
P067.physical: Measure a named four-lead motor and check current-limited slow jog. Five- and six-lead motors need a separate classification.

P070.name: Bench resistance substitution box
P070.connection: Three decade switches → series resistors → test terminals
P070.trial: Compute the tolerance envelope for all 1,000 settings and identify when the two-wire contacts dominate.
P070.physical: Measure every switch position at the terminals on a calibrated meter. Repeat low-ohm settings after operating the switches.

P071.name: Four-wire Kelvin clamp fixture
P071.connection: Two force leads supply a reference shunt → two independent sense leads measure its voltage
P071.trial: Replay ten assumed remounts, comparing separate sense contacts with a sense lead mistakenly sharing the force contact.
P071.physical: Remount a reference shunt ten times, reverse the test current to assess offsets and check the separate contact positions.

P074.name: USB hands-free test trigger pedal
P074.connection: One mechanical pedal → debounced edge → keyboard trigger
P074.trial: Inject switch bounce and reconnect while held, requiring a release before a new trigger.
P074.physical: Record one event per stroke on the host and unplug and reconnect the USB cable with the pedal depressed.

P075.name: Eight-port selectable I2C sensor breakout
P075.connection: Controller → single selected multiplexer channel → identical-address sensor
P075.trial: Prevent selecting multiple same-address channels and show how combined data can resemble a valid zero.
P075.physical: Read two marked same-address sensors on every connector and measure bus signal edges with the intended cable length.

P213.name: Wired director tally lamp
P213.connection: Two isolated contact inputs → program priority → red / green tally
P213.trial: Check all contact combinations, transition latency and loss of both closures.
P213.physical: Verify dark state on unplug and time 100 mixer-contact transitions including simultaneous program and preview.

P214.name: Four-pad USB MIDI trigger box
P214.connection: Four strike envelopes → per-pad threshold → MIDI note and velocity
P214.trial: Replay light and hard strikes with coupled adjacent signals and compare false notes across two thresholds.
P214.physical: Measure missed and doubled notes and velocity response from 30 light and hard strikes on each actual pad.

P215.name: Three-pedal stream shortcut controller
P215.connection: Three independent pedal states → HID report → host held-key set
P215.trial: Exercise simultaneous holds and releases plus 500 strokes per pedal. Compare the reports with a one-key encoder.
P215.physical: Run a hold and release log on each supported host. Measure debounce and verify shortcut behavior inside the intended app.

P219.name: Two-switch wired USB interface
P219.connection: Two dry-contact sockets → configurable key usages → HID held-key set
P219.trial: Replay independent, simultaneous and reconfigured holds, including unplug recovery when a key is still down.
P219.physical: Repeat on the two named hosts with the user's actual switches. Verify socket fit, accessibility and release handling.

P222.name: Two-message tactile playback pad
P222.connection: Record buffer → two-slot nonvolatile journal → two playback selectors
P222.trial: Interrupt a replacement message at each write-operation boundary and verify recovery of the prior committed audio payload.
P222.physical: Record and recover distinct audio after 20 real power cycles and verify tactile identification with the intended user.

P223.name: Dry-contact switch latch and timer
P223.connection: Switch edge → toggle or timed state → low-voltage dry-contact output
P223.trial: Replay both modes on a discrete clock including a press during an active interval and simulated power loss.
P223.physical: Compare each preset with a reference timer for 100 cycles, verify relay release and confirm default open after power loss.

P066.name: Servo characterization dial and load arm
P066.connection: Hanging mass and graduated arm → angle-corrected moment estimate
P066.trial: Compute the load moment over a servo angle sweep and quantify the error from assuming a horizontal arm.
P066.physical: Measure lever length and angle under load, weigh the fixture and test power, holding current and safe servo limits independently.

P073.name: USB-UART service adapter with keyed leads
P073.connection: Synthetic 8N1 transmitter → sampled loopback waveform → decoded bytes
P073.trial: Check alternating and boundary bit patterns across three declared rates and injected clock skew.
P073.physical: Loop back on the populated board and measure actual logic voltage in each keyed position. Test supported hosts.

P211.name: Passive stereo monitor level box
P211.connection: Stereo line-level source → two tapped resistive dividers → finite input load
P211.trial: Bound stereo balance at six settings with finite source and load impedances.
P211.physical: Sweep both channels under a named load and measure tracking, residual hum, noise and mute isolation.

P212.name: Headphone rehearsal splitter amplifier
P212.connection: Two independently loaded outputs per stereo side → shared per-side current budget
P212.trial: Sweep simultaneous dummy loads and reject a source with insufficient per-side peak current.
P212.physical: Test both real outputs into declared dummy loads. Measure output limit, distortion, noise and heating; hearing comfort is outside the model.

P218.name: Large single access button
P218.connection: Wide pivoted face → mechanical moment arm → dry-contact switch
P218.trial: Compare center and four edge activation forces for two hinge positions at a fixed switch lever distance.
P218.physical: Measure activation force and travel at center and edges, inspect return, and test 500 actuations with the actual mounting and intended user.
